copy: Dragging to canvas — the panel keeps its scroll

targets.name: Insert · dragging — CONDITION-ONLY — leaves on drop/dragend, no control (GroupSection.tsx:189-190; ELEMENTS rows only). [not-implemented] the drop it promises: handleBlockDrop re-reads e.dataTransfer past an await and gets '', returns false, and useDropExecution.ts:302-303 hardcodes dropSucceeded = true anyway — a drag can place nothing and be reported as a success (UX-A-01). The valid/invalid indicator is computed for a generic container, not for the thing being dragged (dragCalculations.ts:145-156, UX-A-19). The drop path has no needs-asset branch, so a dragged Image lands with no src while a clicked Image opens Media (dropOperations.tsx:375-527 vs useBlockInsertion.ts:144-153, UX-A-18). Refusal state: sibling board Insert · drop-refused.
